title: SlidePainter turns generated images into slide decks
summary:
A new way to make image-backed slides, a more readable app catalog, and themes you can explore by clicking the logo.

SlidePainter was added for building and reordering slides with generated images. It supports a shared style prompt, reference image, model and render-size choices, Markdown configuration import/export, and PDF export.

The app catalog now formats descriptions as short markdown, showing the original text first and falling back to it if rewriting fails. A follow-up keeps app names, model names and URLs from being rewritten into something else.

Clicking the logo now cycles through theme presets and reveals the AI theme creator. A Pixelart preset was added, while header, tooltip and menu styling was adjusted for readability.

highlights.title: Build slides with SlidePainter
highlights.text: Build and reorder slides with generated images, choose a model and render size, then export the deck as a PDF. Markdown import and export lets you keep the slide configuration, too.

highlights.title: App descriptions get markdown
highlights.text: Browse app descriptions formatted with lists, links and inline code. The catalog shows the original description first and keeps names and URLs intact when rewriting it.

highlights.title: Click through the themes
highlights.text: Click the logo to cycle through theme presets and open the AI theme creator. There’s a new Pixelart preset to try.
